20th November 2026

Gemini 4 Carbon only supports 

low
, 
medium
and 
high
reasoning levels - but Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Gemini 4 Neon both have an extra 
xhigh
level.

I missed that when I added those models to the 

llm-gemini
plugin, which is now fixed in this dot release.

The 

xhigh
setting for Hydrogen makes a significant difference. I updated my Gemini 4 comparison grid - note how Hydrogen at high used 5,311 output tokens and cost 3.99 cents, but the same model at xhigh used 31,477 output tokens, cost 23.61 cents, and produced a pelican that's competitive with Gemini 4 Neon:
